title: Speak About Your Work
description: Practise explaining your job, daily tasks, work schedule and professional goals in simple, clear English.
primary_keyword: speak about your work in English
learning_objectives: Answer common questions about your work

body_markdown:
## 1. Introduce your job

Use a simple structure to explain what you do:

- I work as a ______.
- I work at a ______.
- I have been working here for ______.
- My main responsibility is ______.

Only include details that are true for you.

## 2. Describe your daily responsibilities

Useful work verbs include check, prepare, assist, maintain, guide, coordinate, report and organise.

Examples:

- I check the daily records.
- I assist customers and visitors.
- I prepare a report at the end of my shift.
- I coordinate with my team.
- I report important issues to my supervisor.

## 3. Talk about your work schedule

- My shift starts at seven in the morning.
- I work for eight hours.
- I take a break at noon.
- My shift ends at four in the afternoon.
- I work on weekends when required.

Change the times to match your own schedule.

## 4. Common questions about work

**What do you do?** — I work as a ______.

**What are your responsibilities?** — I am responsible for ______.

**Who do you report to?** — I report to my supervisor.

**What do you like about your work?** — I like working with people and solving problems.

## 5. Practice: Complete the sentences

1. I work as a ______.
2. My main duty is to ______.
3. I work with a team of ______ people.
4. My shift starts at ______.
5. I report important issues to ______.

## 6. Speaking task

Speak for one minute about your job. Mention your role, workplace, three responsibilities and one skill you want to improve. Record yourself and listen for complete sentences.

faq.question: How can I describe my job in English?
faq.answer: State your job title, workplace and two or three main responsibilities using simple sentences.

faq.question: Which tense is useful for daily job duties?
faq.answer: The present simple is useful for regular responsibilities, for example, “I check the records every day.”

faq.question: How can I practise workplace English?
faq.answer: Describe your daily tasks aloud and practise answering common questions about your role.
